relationships.subject: capsazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: Incapacitance data showed that CPZ significantly reduced DMM-induced pain in male mice but not in female mice.

relationships.subject: capsazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: Injection of CPZ significantly suppressed TRPV1 expression in the DRG of male mice only.

relationships.subject: DMM-induced pain
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunofluorescence microscopy analysis demonstrated that DMM surgery increased the expression of TRPV1 in both female and male dorsal root ganglion (DRG).

key_findings: DMM surgery increased DRG TRPV1 in both sexes, but the TRPV1 antagonist capsazepine reduced pain and TRPV1 expression only in male mice.
Cartilage damage developed in both sexes but progressed less in females at late stage.
